create_preprocess_instance: create a Preprocess instance with a config object for speaker diarization data preprocessing
get_labels_in_file: get a list of unique speaker labels from a dataset row containing speaker annotations
get_segments_in_file: get speaker segments as a structured numpy array with start, end times and label indices
get_chunk: extract an audio chunk and its frame-level speaker activity targets at a given start time
chunk_audio_file: chunk an audio file into overlapping segments with waveform, labels, and speaker counts
